_why: The probe has to know which domains are ours, otherwise it cannot tell a citation of ours from anyone else's. Listed explicitly rather than inferred, so a new domain is a deliberate addition.
_source: The five production hosts this generator publishes to, taken from scripts/lib/pack_site_config.js and cross-checked against distribution.config.json (indexnow hosts) and .github/workflows/deploy-distribution.yml (the GSC properties each pack deploys to). local-guides-generator.pages.dev is deliberately absent: it is the starter pack's training sandbox, not a published content property, and counting a citation of it would inflate the number.
